feature.title: Phone and iPad reader: install it, read offline, update cleanly
feature.problem: The reader is a web page: on an iPhone 'Add to Home Screen' opens it like a browser tab, and with no signal (a plane, the underground) every screen fails with 'Couldn't load this chapter'. The owner reads on the move. Phase 4 makes the reader an installable app that opens on its own icon, keeps the courses you choose (and every chapter you open) on the device, lets you read, answer quizzes and keep your place offline, sends what you did once you are back online, and tells you when a new version is ready instead of changing under you.
nonGoals: Asking the tutor offline: it needs the server; the Ask button already says 'Tutor needs a connection'.
Push notifications (a finished build, a new course): later, if at all.
Offline for the desktop app at /: the service worker's scope is /m/ only.
Background sync while the app is closed: iOS has none; queued progress goes when the app is next open and online.
Plain http://coursewright:8080: browsers only run service workers on https (the tailnet name) or localhost; over http the reader works as today, online only.

components.control: Service worker scoped to /m/, built with vite-plugin-pwa (Workbox generateSW) in the reader's Vite config only
components.why: precache manifest of hashed assets and runtime caching rules are generated from the build, so a deploy can never ship a stale list; the desktop app and its MSW worker at / are untouched
components.rejected: a hand-written sw.js (asset lists drift with every build) and one worker for both apps (the desktop app has no offline need and its dev MSW worker owns /)

components.control: Precache: the app shell, every reader chunk except Mermaid's, Inkling, the Flowmovie player, app-switch.js and the icons; Mermaid cached on first use
components.why: about 1 MB that the reader always needs offline; Mermaid's chunks are several MB and few chapters use them
components.rejected: precaching everything (Mermaid alone would multiply the first install)

components.control: API GETs (courses, course, chapter, chapter progress) NetworkFirst with a 4 s timeout, then the cached copy
components.why: online you always see the latest; on a bad connection you get your saved copy instead of a spinner
components.rejected: StaleWhileRevalidate (shows yesterday's progress first) and persisting TanStack Query to localStorage (5 MB cap, a second store of the same data)

components.control: 'Save for offline' fetches every chapter of the course through the same cache, 4 at a time, with a progress row and Stop
components.why: one explicit action before a trip; chapters opened normally are kept anyway, so most reading is covered without it
components.rejected: saving every course automatically (hundreds of chapters on a phone) and a separate download format

components.control: An outbox in localStorage for progress and quiz attempts, sent in order on 'online' and on app start; quiz checked on the device from the chapter's answer
components.why: iOS has no background sync; the queue is small and the server's writes are idempotent per chapter/question
components.rejected: Workbox background sync (not on Safari) and blocking the quiz offline

components.control: Update popover when a new worker is waiting (registerType 'prompt'); Reload activates it
components.why: the reader never reloads under you mid-chapter; the place is kept by the existing scroll marks
components.rejected: autoUpdate (reloads while reading) and silently waiting for every tab to close (iOS standalone apps rarely close)

components.control: Install row: Share-sheet steps on iOS/iPadOS, a button from beforeinstallprompt on Chromium, hidden when display-mode is standalone
components.why: Safari has no install prompt, so the steps are the only way; Chrome offers the real prompt
components.rejected: a banner on the library (nags every visit)

components.control: Web app manifest at /m/manifest.webmanifest: name 'Coursewright Reader', id/start_url/scope /m/, display standalone, the existing icons, theme and background #0B0D10
components.why: opens on its own icon with no browser bar; the existing site.webmanifest stays for the desktop app
components.rejected: editing site.webmanifest (its scope is the desktop app)

components.control: Offline bar under the top bar while navigator.onLine is false or a request fell back to the cache
components.why: says once why some things are dimmed; no per-screen error
components.rejected: a toast (disappears) and nothing (reads as a broken app)
